name: Punchcard
summary: An 8-digit backup code that punches holes in a manila card, which then feeds through a reader
about: A backup code sign-in for people who lost their phone, set on a teal desk. Every digit you type punches its row on an old-style manila card and the paper bit falls away; with all eight in, the card slides into a reader, a light bar sweeps the holes and the screen says whether the code works. A used code gets a red USED stamp and is crossed off your saved list, so each code works only once.
how: Type or paste an 8-digit backup code; each digit punches a hole in its column
Backspace, Delete and the arrow keys move between the boxes and patch holes back
Or press a saved code in the demo list; the crossed-out one was already used
With all eight digits in, the card is read and the reader shows CODE OK, NO MATCH or ALREADY USED
Press Use another code to try one of the codes that are left
